_comment: Site-wide settings read by the static page generators. Leave newsletter.url empty to hide the subscribe box. mode 'form': url is the form action (e.g. Buttondown: https://buttondown.com/api/emails/embed-subscribe/<username>, field 'email'). mode 'iframe': url is the provider's embed URL (Beehiiv, Substack).
_comment_analytics: analytics.script_src: the provider's script URL; analytics.attributes: its data-* attributes. Plausible: script_src https://plausible.io/js/script.js, attributes {"data-domain": "quantarenas.com"}. Umami: script_src https://cloud.umami.is/script.js, attributes {"data-website-id": "<id>"}. Leave script_src empty for no analytics.
_comment_verification: Search Console / Bing Webmaster ownership tokens: paste only the content value of the <meta name="google-site-verification"> or <meta name="msvalidate.01"> tag they give you.
_comment_ads: Ads on static content pages only (see AD_SECTIONS in scripts/static_site.py). adsense_client: the ca-pub id; AdSense decides placement (Auto ads). native: one labelled block above the footer, loaded only when it nears the viewport; src and container come from the ad network's embed code. Empty values switch that network off.
